projects.title: SoundCloud
projects.summary: Developed and shipped monetization products including new ad products and SoundCloud Go and Go+
projects.imageAlt: The SoundCloud app on two phones

layers.title: What you see
layers.note: Feed-based ads that sit in the listening feed, and the SoundCloud Go and Go+ screens that opened a new revenue stream.

layers.title: The app
layers.note: The iOS side of SoundCloud Go and Go+: their UI and payment flow, plus a modularized Monetization codebase that sped up feature delivery.

layers.title: The services
layers.note: The Scala backend for the feed ads, which grew SoundCloud's ad products and sales revenue.

projects.title: Noggin
projects.summary: Developed and launched a first-to-market subscription streaming service for Nickelodeon revitalizing the Noggin brand
projects.imageAlt: The Noggin app on a tablet, with mascots peeking over the top

layers.title: What you see
layers.note: The NOGGIN app: a subscription that took Nickelodeon's brand direct to consumers for the first time.

layers.title: The app
layers.note: An iOS app built around UI. I implemented the dynamic Moose and Zee animations, which react to activity like fast swiping or long idle time, and themed parallax on the episode lists for shows in the home screen's infinite carousel. UIKit Dynamics adds playful touches.

projects.title: NBCUniversal
projects.summary: Developed the mobile apps and backend for several NBCU brands including, but not limited to, USA, SyFy, Bravo, E!, and Telemundo
projects.imageAlt: The USA Network app on a phone and the Bravo Now app on a tablet

layers.title: The app
layers.note: I led the Apple SSO integration across nine brand products, so signing in stayed seamless for viewers.

layers.title: The services
layers.note: Backend for Frontends that cut the impact of third-party downtime and brought recovery from days to hours.

layers.title: The infrastructure
layers.note: AWS deployment automation and Pact contract tests for faster, safer releases, plus the migration from AWS to Google Cloud and Kubernetes.

projects.title: Peachi
projects.summary: First of its kind fashion marketplace utilizing a user's unique style profile to provide outfit inspiration and inspired shopping
projects.imageAlt: The Peachi app on two phones

layers.title: What you see
layers.note: A marketplace that recommends outfits matched to your personal style, built with React Native (Expo).

layers.title: The app
layers.note: The Sizing Calculator, built during the NYC Antler accelerator, drove a 27% uptick in organic sign-ups and a 4% purchase conversion in under a week.

layers.title: The services
layers.note: The Python (Flask) backend behind the app, the other half of the stack I led as co-founder and CTO.
